description: Curated Claude Code mods that customize the Claude Code experience

mods.name: VibeShield Secret-Leak Guardrail Mod

mods.installCommand: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1 claude plugin marketplace add zColdWater/vibeshield-claude-mod && claude plugin install vibeshield-mod
